stem.text: A 0.216 g sample of aluminium carbide reacts with an excess of water to produce methane gas. This is the only carbon-containing product formed in the reaction. This methane gas burns completely in $\text{O}_2$ to form $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ and $\text{CO}_2$ only. The volume of $\text{CO}_2$ produced at room temperature and pressure is $108\,\text{cm}^{3}$.
What is the formula of aluminium carbide?
